name: Wrapped Deltix
description: Wrapped Deltix (wDLTX) is a fixed-supply BEP-20 token on BNB Chain: 50,000,000 tokens, no minting capability, no owner or admin functions, non-upgradeable, 0% transfer tax. Note: wDLTX is currently a standalone asset — there is no conversion or 1:1 backing between native DLTX and wDLTX.
